clean.rationale_short: The headline ($0, only Free coffee $100) is the most prominent element, immediately conveying the offer. The product (coffee cup) is central and visually anchors the ad. The call-to-action (Claim your free coffee & reward now) is highlighted in a distinct circular button for easy identification. The background context (date, time, terms) is secondary and placed at the bottom.
